subject: POC success criteria and hosting decision — VPC staging option
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@healthgen.ai>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + proposed POC plan and hosting options

Alex — thanks again for the demo earlier. Quick recap and a proposed plan so we can get your team into an evaluation that proves the performance and cost profile you care about. Attached: redwood-poc-plan-v1.pdf (includes timelines, success criteria, and minimal onboarding checklist).

Key outcomes from our call:
- Success criteria: 95th percentile latency < 300ms for single-turn Q&A; end-to-end throughput of 12 rps for batch eval; reproducible semantic-similarity > 0.88 on your eval set.
- Data handling: no customer PII will be logged in hosted evaluation.
- Preferred initial scope: 2 model variants, 7-day run, ingestion of 10k test records.

Hosting options (high level):
1) Hosted Redwood API: fastest to start (hours), limited network isolation. Good for feature validation.
2) Dedicated sandbox (reserved pool): predictable throughput, single-tenant GPUs, moderate setup (1–2 days).
3) VPC trial (customer-managed networking): best for integration testing and compliance; requires IP allowlists, VPC peering or private link, and legal/ops sign-off (3–7 business days).

Ask: Can you confirm which hosting option you prefer for the POC and the target start window? If VPC, please share the network contact and any required security questionnaire fields.

Next steps I propose:
- If you prefer hosted: we spin up the sample harness and demo data in 48 hours.
- If you prefer Dedicated or VPC: we lock in environment and kick off provisioning with Karthik (cc’d) and Stephanie for eval plan details.

Thanks — I’ll coordinate resources once you confirm.

—
Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
attach: redwood-poc-plan-v1.pdf
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 09:16:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Recap + proposed POC plan and hosting options

Internal note — aligning ops and security before we confirm with HealthGen. Summary of considerations and action items below. Please keep this internal for now.

High-level recommendation: Offer a staged VPC pilot (scoped VPC/staging subnet) rather than full VPC-onboard for initial 7-day eval. This balances their compliance asks while allowing us to instrument and observe runtime at true network latency.

Operational checklist & owners:
- Network prep: Karthik to provide exact egress/IP allowlist and private link options (target +3 business days). Owner: k.i.
- Eval harness & datasets: Stephanie to create the eval job with their 10k records and the two model variants; include measurement hooks for latency, throughput, and semantic-similarity. Owner: s.n.
- Security artifacts: I will pull our SOC 2 summary and likely required items (log retention, encryption, key management) and produce an evidence bundle. Owner: h.s. (target +2 business days).
- Contract / MOU: Ben to confirm commercial window and whether a short MOU is needed to enable VPC/network work.

Questions for Ben to surface to HealthGen:
1) Do they require customer-managed KMS or is Redwood KMS acceptable for the trial?
2) Which subnets / CIDR ranges can they open for the staging subnet?

Tentative timeline if HealthGen approves VPC staging by Tue next week:
- Tue: sign MOU (simple 1-page) + network details shared
- Wed–Fri: provisioning + connectivity tests
- Mon (following): start 7-day eval run

I’ll draft the SOC2 evidence list and share internally for review before sending externally.

—
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Customer Solutions (Trials)
Redwood Inference
From: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@healthgen.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Paula Santos <psantos@healthgen.ai>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 10:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Recap + proposed POC plan and hosting options

Ben — thanks, this is helpful. We reviewed the proposed criteria with the ML team and a few updates:

- Success criteria tweak: semantic-similarity threshold to be evaluated on our holdout set — target > 0.86 (we’ll provide the holdout).
- Latency SLA: our production path expects < 250ms 95th at 2k token window; for this POC we are okay with < 300ms as you listed but we’ll note differences when using VPC staging.
- Hosting preference: we prefer the VPC staging option for the POC. We don’t need a permanent VPC — a staging subnet for the 7-day run is sufficient.

Security input: attaching our security questionnaire (security-questions.pdf). High-level asks are: encryption at rest, KMS options, audit logging availability, and SOC 2 artifacts. We prefer Redwood-managed KMS if that’s easiest for a time-boxed trial.

Procurement timeline: we can sign a short MOU to enable the network work within 48 hours of agreement. Procurement for a larger contract will follow but is separate.

Please confirm whether your team can provision a staging subnet and the earliest start date if we sign the MOU tomorrow.

Thanks — Alex
Alex Morgan
Director of ML Engineering
HealthGen AI
attach: security-questions.pdf
